name: The Westin Nashville
positioning: Downtown Nashville hotel near Broadway and Music City Center, with a rooftop pool and lounge 27 floors up
best_for: Travelers who want a downtown base near Broadway and Music City Center
Guests who want a rooftop pool and lounge with skyline views

facts.text: The hotel is in downtown Nashville near Broadway and Music City Center.
Oak Steakhouse pairs farm-fresh dishes with an extensive selection of Italian and Spanish wines.
Rhapsody Spa has a co-ed dry cedar sauna, hydro-experience steam showers and a relaxation lounge.
The fitness center has Peloton bikes and a stretch and yoga room.
The Bike Program gives guests complimentary access to bicycles to explore The Gulch, Music Row and downtown.
Hotel suites feature extra room, modern design and sweeping views.
Pets are welcome at the hotel.
The lobby has crystal chandeliers and leather seating.
Each guest room has a walk-in shower.

highlights.text: L27 Rooftop Pool sits 27 floors above the Nashville skyline.
Rhapsody Spa offers body treatments and a custom collection of IV therapies.
The Presidential and Executive Suites are adorned with unique artwork and playful elements.
L27 Rooftop Lounge offers craft cocktails, bites, live music and DJ beats with views of the downtown skyline.

considerations.text: The rooftop cocktail pool is seasonal; the indoor pool is open year-round.
WhataHotel notes a busy urban setting with potential street noise.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing typical of luxury downtown hotels.

sources.title: Conde Nast Traveler: The Westin Nashville
